lines.en: Yeon Gusesa High Commander (막리지) of Goguryeo The High Commander. He chair
I have heard that a true man needs only one person to cherish, and one person to serve, and that is enough.

They name him Seohyun. The first voice he hears is his mother’s, in a Surabol accent. His father says nothing until the boy is asleep. Then he leans over the cradle and says something very quietly, in the accent of a harbour that isn’t there any more.
How many days. King Euija As long as it takes. Forever, if he’s charming. Gyebek Forever is not a number, Majesty.
Wait… wait. The Supreme Commander of a country — a grown man, a man who leads a kingdom —
